text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moroccan MPs unanimously adopt laws setting the number of representatives and councillors for the new bicameral parliament.
- Morocco to mark the 44th anniversary of the Revolution of the King and the People on August 20.
- Spanish fishermen operating in Moroccan waters threaten to hold protests to press for compensation for the period allowing fish stocks to recover.
- Central city of Meknes will host a four day congress of the international conference of lawyers starting September 16.
- MPs pay homage to the late Ali Yata, leader of the Socialist and Progress Party (SPP) who died following a road accident.
